1.en: And do not accept a false report
and do not associate with a wrongdoer
to be for him a witness of injustice

2.en: Do not be a follower of the many toward evil
and do not respond in a dispute so as to tilt it
rather, behind the majority, then incline

3.en: And do not show favor to the poor in his dispute.

4.ja: ואד'א פאגית ת'ור עדווך. או חמארה צ'לא
4.en: And if you come upon the ox of your enemy, or his donkey, going astray
4.he: כִּי תִפְגַּע שׁוֹר אֹיִבְךָ אוֹ חֲמֹרוֹ--תֹּעֶה

4.en: return it to him, a returning.

5.ja: ואד'א ראית חמאר שאניך. ראבצא תחת חמלה
5.en: And if you see the donkey of one who hates you crouching under its load
5.he: כִּי-תִרְאֶה חֲמוֹר שֹׂנַאֲךָ רֹבֵץ תַּחַת מַשָּׂאוֹ

5.en: then refrain from leaving it thus
rather, unload it, unload it along with him.

6.ja: לא תמייל חכם מסכינך פי כ'צומתה
6.en: Do not tilt the judgment of your poor in his dispute.

7.en: And the righteous and the innocent — do not kill them
for I will not acquit a wrongdoer.

8.en: And do not take a bribe

8.ja: פאן אלרשא יעמי עיון אלבצרא ען אלחק
8.en: for a bribe blinds the eyes of those who see away from the truth
and falsifies words that are just.

9.en: And do not oppress a stranger
for you know the soul of the stranger

9.ja: וטאל מא כנתם ג'רבא פי בלד מצר
9.en: seeing how long you were strangers in the land of Egypt.

10.en: Six years you shall sow your land

11.en: But in the seventh you shall leave it and not scatter seed in it
and the poor of your people shall eat from it
and what remains of it the wild creatures of the desert shall eat
So shall you do with your vineyard and your olive grove.

12.en: Six days you shall perform your labors
and on the seventh day you shall keep the Sabbath
that your ox and your donkey may rest
and the son of your maidservant and the stranger with you may find ease.

13.en: And all that I have told you, keep
and the name of other objects of worship do not mention
and let it not be heard from your mouth.

14.en: Three times you shall make pilgrimage to Me in the year.

15.en: And the festival of unleavened bread — keep it

15.ja: סבעה' איאם תאכל פטירא כמא אמרתך
15.en: seven days you shall eat unleavened bread as I commanded you
15.he: שִׁבְעַת יָמִים תֹּאכַל מַצּוֹת כַּאֲשֶׁר צִוִּיתִךָ

15.en: at the time of the month of the roasting of the barley
for in it you went out from Egypt
And do not appear before Me empty-handed.

16.ja: וחג אלחצאד בכור עמלך. אלד'י תזרעה פי אלצחרי'
16.en: And the festival of the harvest, of the firstfruits of your labor which you sow in the open country
16.he: וְחַג הַקָּצִיר בִּכּוּרֵי מַעֲשֶׂיךָ אֲשֶׁר תִּזְרַע בַּשָּׂדֶה

16.en: and the festival of the ingathering, at the going out of the year
when you gather in your labors from the open country.

18.en: And do not slaughter My Passover offering upon leavened bread

18.ja: ולא תביית שחום חגי אלי' אלג'דאה
18.en: and do not let the fat of My festival offering remain until morning.

19.en: And the first of the firstfruits of your land

19.ja: תאתי בהא אלי' בית אללה רבך
19.en: bring them to the house of God your Lord
And do not cook meat with milk.

20.en: Behold, I am sending an angel before you
to guard you on the way

20.ja: ויאתי בך. אלי' אלמוצ'ע אלד'י אצלחתה לך
20.en: and to bring you to the place which I have prepared for you.

21.en: and accept his command and do not oppose him
for he will not pardon your transgression
for My name is with him.

22.en: For if you accept his command
and do all that I say
I will be an enemy to those who are enemies to you
and I will harm those who harm you.

23.en: And when My angel goes before you

23.ja: ואדכ'לך. אלי' אלאמוריין ואלחתיין. ואלפרזיין ואלכנעאניין
23.en: and brings you in to the Amorites and the Hittites and the Perizzites and the Canaanites

24.en: do not bow down to their objects of worship and do not serve them
and do not act as their deeds
rather, demolish them with a demolishing
and break their altars with a breaking.

25.en: and He will bless your food and your drink
and will remove diseases from you.

26.ja: לא תכון מת'כל ועאקר פי בלדך
26.en: There shall be none who loses young and none barren in your land
and the count of your days — I will complete them.

27.en: And I will send My dread before you

27.ja: ואהים גמיע אלקום. אלד'ין תציר אליהם
27.en: and I will throw into confusion all the people unto whom you come
and I will make your enemies turn their backs before you.

28.en: And I will send the plague before you

28.ja: פתטרד אלחויין ואלכנעאניין. ואלחתיין מן בין ידיך
28.en: and it shall drive out the Hivites and the Canaanites and the Hittites from before you.

29.ja: לא אטרדהם מן בין ידיך פי סנה ואחדה
29.en: I will not drive them out from before you in a single year
and the wild creatures of the desert multiply against you.

30.ja: לכן קלילא קלילא. אטרדהם מן בין ידיך
30.en: But little by little I will drive them out from before you
and take possession of the land.

31.ja: ואגעל תכ'מך. מן בחר אלקלזם אלי' בחר פלסטין
31.en: And I will set your border from the Sea of Qulzum (Red Sea) to the Sea of Philistia
and from the wilderness to the Euphrates

31.ja: באן אסלם פי אידיכם סכאן אלבלד
31.en: for I will deliver into your hands the inhabitants of the land
31.he: כִּי אֶתֵּן בְּיֶדְכֶם אֵת יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ

31.en: and you shall drive them out from before you.

32.ja: לא תעהד מעהם. ומע מעבודאתהם עהדא
32.en: Do not make a covenant with them, nor with their objects of worship, a covenant.

33.en: And they shall not dwell in your land
lest they lead you astray from Me
by your serving their objects of worship
for they would be to you a noose.
